notes: True homograph of the existing H2114 ("become estranged"), both spelled זור -- added as זור² per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H2114 is retroactively renamed זור¹ in this same batch.

Qal passive (Isa.1.6, זֹרוּ, "[wounds] have not been closed") is attested but wasn't part of the original request -- added per the full-stem-coverage check. This is a rare stem (internal passive of qal, letter 'Q') -- flagged per the maintenance guide's "capture rare stems" requirement.
Gloss collision: shares "squeeze" with the existing לחץ (H3905, "squeeze; oppress") -- distinct roots, disambiguating search alias added.

Trimmed qal_passive's "be pressed out; be closed (of a wound)" to "be closed (of a wound)" per the compound-gloss trim audit: Isa.1.6 says the wounds "have not been closed" -- "be pressed out" is an inference from the root's general "press" meaning, not something this citation itself states.
